articles.title: Race Cars Zoom Past the White House!
articles.summary: IndyCar's first-ever race in Washington, D.C. turned famous streets into a track. Florida's Kyle Kirkwood won, leading most laps. Thousands cheered as a real bald eagle flew over!

articles.title: Why Weather Is Getting Wilder
articles.summary: Scientists say climate change is making extreme weather more common. They point to bigger wildfires, floods, and heat waves. One expert warns we might be 'the frog in boiling water.'

articles.title: Japan and China: Trying to Be Friends Again
articles.summary: Japanese lawmakers visited China to fix a big fight over Taiwan. The argument started when Japan's leader said it might use military force if China attacked Taiwan. Now they're trying to talk.
